title: Concept: Link to a shell history file
description: A link to a .bash_history file in a response gives every reader the same view the bank has internally: Shell history records the exact commands an operator ran, including database clients, curl calls with tokens and deployment steps.
applicability: Home-directory hosting, backup browsers and misconfigured static servers.
risk: Command history tells an attacker the exact tooling and the hosts it was pointed at.
